## Decision

gw migrate MUST NOT be run in its current form. Fix target tracker, event-type scope, collision policy, and orphan-slug discovery before any reconciliation run.

## Rationale

src/gw/migrate/index.ts defaults nextTracker to .groundwork/next, not the .groundwork path gw journal reads. It drops 2795 non-DECISION events. It collapses 49 DECISION events last-write-wins; 37 of those carry differing decision text. It skips 11 slugs with no motive directory. Running it today would write a third disconnected store.

## Alternatives Considered

- Run migrate as-is and patch afterward — rejected, data would already be lost
- Skip migrate entirely and write a new reconciliation tool — under consideration
